summary: This is an environment configuration file that sets up variables for a Joomla 5 website running in Docker containers. It specifies database credentials, admin user details, service versions, and port mappings needed to launch and connect to the application.

explanations.2: CONTAINER_PREFIX names the Docker containers consistently so they're easy to identify and reference when managing multiple containers together.
explanations.15: MYSQL_PORT specifies a custom port number (3301) to access the MySQL database from outside its container, since port 3306 might already be in use.
explanations.21: WEB_PORT (8081) is the port you'd visit in your browser like http://localhost:8081 to access the Joomla website.
